svg.title: Cache-aside without the stampede: the fix for the herd that hits your DB when a hot key expires
svg.desc: A row of cache key-slots above a database cylinder, with a herd of client arrows pouring down through the one empty expired slot straight into the database. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Cache-aside without the stampede: the fix for the herd that hits your DB when a hot key expires”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3709584422.
